visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a lavish Chinese New Year feast featuring roast duck and rice, which transitions to a medium shot of a woman with long hair wearing a light blue sweatshirt. She is in a modern, well-lit living room, holding a smartphone to take a photo of a large television screen displaying that same food image. (2) She is briefly seen in a hallway wearing a brown puffer jacket, followed by a close-up of hands with manicured nails scratching a colorful lottery ticket on a light-colored wooden table. (3) The scene shifts back to the living room where she is lounging on a beige sofa, now wearing a thick, fuzzy blue and white character hoodie; she holds a bag of jerky and eats a piece. (4) A detailed shot shows a gift box being opened, revealing silver and gold sachets of 'Hsin Tung Yang' chicken essence and multiple bags of 'horizon' meat jerky. (5) A golden-hued liquid is poured from a sachet into a clear, double-walled glass cup, followed by a shot of the woman drinking the liquid while sitting on the sofa. (6) She holds up various packages of beef and pork jerky, pointing to the ingredient lists on the back of the bags, and takes large bites of the jerky while looking directly into the lens. (7) Finally, she stands in the living room holding three large maroon 'Hsin Tung Yang' gift bags, giving a thumbs-up gesture as the camera focuses on the brand logo.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long brown hair, wearing a light blue sweatshirt initially, then a brown puffer jacket, and later a blue-and-white fuzzy hooded loungewear set.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a modern apartment living room with a large TV, light wood shelving, a beige sofa, and a cat tree. Festive banners are hung above the TV. Some shots also show a close-up of a wooden dining table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo festive BGM with traditional instrumental synthesis starts. A female voice speaks with high energy and clarity, articulating Chinese New Year activities. (2) A sharp transition SFX leads into a continuous electronic pop track. The narrator's pitch increases as she introduces specific brand products. (3) A distinct liquid pouring sound occurs when she describes the chicken essence, followed by metallic foil rustling. (4) Percussive chewing sounds with high spectral clarity are emphasized during the jerky tasting phase, creating an ASMR-like effect. (5) Cartoon-style boing sound effects mark scene transitions. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat rhythm. (6) The voice volume remains consistent but the speed increases as she lists numerous ingredients, ending with a final bright orchestral chime.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Routine Compilation -> Product Deep Dive -> Crisis -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a festive commercial and recommendation guide for Chinese New Year gifts. It begins by listing common holiday activities to build a relatable context before introducing 'Hsin Tung Yang' Chicken Essence and 'horizon' jerky as healthy, additive-free gift options. The creator emphasizes ingredients and health benefits to appeal to modern health-conscious consumers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features direct product demonstrations, close-ups of packaging and labels, and a clear call to action to purchase via the official website.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high editing pace typical of social media shorts to keep viewers engaged. The combination of lifestyle vlogging and professional product presentation makes the endorsement feel personal yet authoritative.
